message.content:
Since \(29 \equiv 1 \pmod{7}\), we have:
\[
29^{13} \equiv 1^{13} \equiv 1 \pmod{7}.
\]

Now compute \(5^{13} \pmod{7}\). By Fermat's little theorem, \(5^6 \equiv 1 \pmod{7}\). Since \(13 \equiv 1 \pmod{6}\),
\[
5^{13} \equiv 5^1 \equiv 5 \pmod{7}.
\]

Thus,
\[
29^{13} - 5^{13} \equiv 1 - 5 \equiv -4 \equiv 3 \pmod{7}.
\]

The answer is 3.
